reason: Check scripts only (#621 items 3-6): check-arrow-direction reads each locale's catalogue slices from its own index.ts and holds every catalogue's mandatory arrow pairs to the manifest's number; check-form-direction holds the listed expression fields to dir="ltr" and fails when a listed field matches no input; check-functional-glyphs reads a JSX expression inside a fragment; check-mobile-query and the arrow check's transform clause read every stylesheet under src/.
